comment: Inverse-mapping (line->addr) cases, SPEC §5.6. Computed by an INDEPENDENT parse of the Nova symbol file (scratchpad explore_inverse.js) and hand-verified — NOT derived from resolver.cjs. Files are matched by basename inside the test.

cases.name: breakpoint intent at an aliased address: kernel.s:734 must bind to $FD40 (kernel data intent, spec §8)
same address, other intent: loader.asm:150 also maps to $FD40
snap FORWARD from a line before any code (kernel.s:1 -> first entry line 36)
end of file snaps BACKWARD to the nearest line before (kernel.s:99999 -> 734)
overlay file resolves in ITS module view (megabuilding:835, module 0)
overlay file is invisible in the resident-only view
stepping: next different loader.asm line after pc=$FD40/line 150 is $FD43 (the run continues)
stepping past the file's last entry returns -1 (fall back to instruction step)
